Instructions for Use
Device description: The Helix Embolization Coil System is a embolization coil. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Helix Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5 and 3.0 Tesla
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 40 T/m or less
- Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4-W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
- Scan for up to 10 minutes
- Followed by a wait time of 60 minutes
- Body transmit coil only
- Any receive-only coil may be used
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Helix Embolization Coil System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
